item.description: Wrexham AFC added a further three points, moving back into the play-off positions, with a thrilling victory over Ipswich Town. item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC Women (p) 2-2 Cardiff City Women (Genero Adran Trophy Final)
item.description: Liz Craven saved two penalties as Wrexham AFC Women beat Cardiff City to win the Genero Adran Trophy for the first time in Bangor. After a 2-2 draw in 90 minutes, Craven saved Cardiff’s first two penalties in the shoot-out, and Faye Knox scored the Red Dragons’ winning spot-kick as they triumphed 4-2.
